reference_materials: Source parameter cards derived from source_bindings.json, without evaluator acceptance flags
Explicit unknown/ambiguity cards for every listed source gap
Labels on all reagents/carriers/stations; no hidden chemical identity puzzles

task_only_quantity_system.transfer_rule: One aliquot per declared component card, or one vessel-covering fill for a premixed reagent. This is an authored discrete token and has no inferred microliter value.
task_only_quantity_system.capacity_rule: One specimen carrier per work slot; a fresh wash replaces previous fluid token. Component recipe metadata supplies source concentrations, not computed mixing stoichiometry.
task_only_quantity_system.supply_rule: Enough tokens for nominal path and one replacement branch; requesting replenishment at receiving creates a labeled authored replenishment event.

manual_prep_boundary: Generic task aliquots do not validate a physical dilution calculation. Source-provided mixture composition is an identity card; agent must select and combine its declared components, with no fabricated volumetric recipe.
